page.layout: One column of index entries on the left of the scan, each line with its page numbers to the right. Above the column the letters "I N" stand as the alphabetical heading. The right edge of the page is cut off.; One column of index entries, with page references at the right edge, which is cut off. Running head at top. No page number visible.; One column of page references at the right edge, running down the page, with the words of a index entry at the foot of the column (integritas; intelli-gentia), each on its own line. The left part of the lines is cut off.
page.notes: Right-hand edge of the scan is cut, so the last digit of some page numbers (244, 231, 239) is uncertain. Ingemiscere: the page number could be 35 or 39. Greek/Latin spelling "infiingere" is copied as printed. The right-hand page references are cut off at the edge of this part; only the visible digits are given, and those marked [?] are partly hidden. The entry "infpergere" has its "457" printed on a separate line beneath it. The word after "int" in the integrè entry and the end of the last line are cut off. The first letters of "instabiles" and "institiæ" are unclear. Left parts of the lines are cut off, so the entries are fragments and are kept as they stand. Some page references are cut at the left edge (e.g. "70. 387", "07.220", "04.708").
